stories.title: From sexual violence to mobile phones, what's changing for French pupils?
stories.summary: Millions of French students are heading back to school this week and with that comes a host of new rules for what will be the last school year of Emmanuel Macron's presidency. From phone bans to exam schedules, Camille Knight takes a look at what's changing in the French school system, and why those changes are being put in place.

stories.title: Falklands: After Netanyahu's son backs Argentina sovereignty, Trump hints US may review UK's claim
stories.summary: Falklands: After Netanyahu's son backs Argentina sovereignty, Trump hints US may review UK's claim Submitted by Elis Gjevori on Tue, 09/01/2026 - 12:15 As Britain steps up its criticism of Israeli policy in Gaza and the occupied West Bank, Israeli figures have thrown their weight behind Buenos Aires in dispute over south Atlantic islands Yair Netanyahu (left) and Sara Netanyahu listen to Benjamin Netanyahu's speech at the 80th session of the UN General Assembly on 26 September 2025 in New York City (AFP/Alexi J Rosenfeld) Off Just days after Yair Netanyahu, the son of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, suggested that the Falkland Islands belonged to Buenos Aires, US President Donald
article_sentences: Just days after Yair Netanyahu, the son of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, suggested that the Falkland Islands belonged to Buenos Aires, US President Donald Trump publicly indicated his support for Argentina's position.
Speaking to reporters in the Oval Office on Monday, Trump was asked whether the US was reviewing its position on the Falkland Islands.
“I always review every position – that’s just one of many,” Trump said.

The US leader's comments mark the first time that Washington suggested it could reconsider its position on British sovereignty over the contested territory, known to Argenitinians as the Islas Malvinas.
Trump did not elaborate on what he meant.
Argentina and the UK both assert sovereignty over the South Atlantic archipelago, which triggered a war between the two countries in 1982.
An overwhelming majority of the territory's 3,600 residents back British rule.
A leaked Pentagon memo from April suggested that Washington could use the Falklands as leverage in negotiations with the UK.

Trump’s comments followed a series of posts over the weekend by Yair Netanyahu- a 35 year old political activist and son of the current Israeli leader- in which he questioned British sovereignty over the islands.
Writing in Spanish, he declared: “The Falkland Islands belong to Argentina!”
The Israeli national, who lives in the US, later boasted: “I contributed to Israel-Argentina relations with my tweet about the Malvinas Islands,” using Argentina’s name for the islands.
Argentina’s staunchly pro-Israel President Javier Milei reposted Yair’s comments about the islands.

stories.title: Iranian Foreign Ministry warns US against any 'provocations'
stories.summary: Iranian Foreign Ministry Spokesman Esmail Baghaei stressed that the United States must be held accountable "for numerous violations of the memorandum of understanding"
article_sentences: TEHRAN, September 1.
Iran's armed forces will respond to any provocative US actions, Iranian Foreign Ministry Spokesman Esmail Baghaei said.
"We must remain vigilant and monitor the enemy's actions.
No provocation will go unanswered by our armed forces," he said at a press briefing.
Baghaei also stressed that the United States must be held accountable "for numerous violations of the memorandum of understanding."
The United States and Israel launched a war against Iran on February 28.
Washington and Tehran signed the memorandum of understanding in June calling for an immediate ceasefire on all fronts, including in Lebanon.
However, the United States resumed large-scale strikes on Iran overnight on July 8, accusing Tehran of violating the agreement regarding the Strait of Hormuz.
On August 30, US forces struck two missile launchers on Larak Island in southern Iran.
Tehran responded by striking US forces in Jordan.

stories.title: Trade turnover between Russia, Tajikistan up 25% last year — Putin
stories.summary: There are 320 enterprises with Russian participation operating in Tajikistan, the Russian leader noted
article_sentences: BISHKEK, September 1.

Trade turnover between Russia and Tajikistan added 25.1% in 2025, and another 25% in the first six months of this year, Russian President Vladimir Putin said at a meeting with Tajikistan’s leader Emomali Rahmon as part of the SCO summit.
"Trade turnover increased by 25.1% last year, and by another 25% in the first half of this year, which represents a very good pace," he said.
There are 320 enterprises with Russian participation operating in Tajikistan, Putin noted, adding that 96% of all transactions are conducted in national currencies.

"We stick to the economic cooperation program for 2024-2027, and we are moving at a very good pace in accordance with the plan of joint measures to increase mutual trade by a factor of 2.5 by 2030," he stressed.

stories.title: US, Russian finance ministers’ meeting signals thaw in ties — expert
stories.summary: Channels of interaction between the countries are being restored, making it more likely to reach constructive solutions, Alexander Abramov added
article_sentences: MOSCOW, September 1.

The latest meeting between Russian Finance Minister Anton Siluanov and his US counterpart Scott Bessent signals a move toward restoring relations between the two countries, Alexander Abramov, head of the Presidential Academy’s Laboratory for Analysis of Institutions and Financial Markets, told TASS.

"This face-to-face meeting between the two countries’ finance ministers sends a very important signal to the world that serious work is beginning to restore relations and resolve conflicts that have been building up," he said.
Channels of interaction between the countries are being restored, making it more likely to reach constructive solutions, the expert added.
The Russian Finance Minister last met the US Treasury Secretary in person in 2019, he noted.

In 2022, the Russian Finance Minister participated in a meeting of G20 finance ministers and central bank governors via a video link, when representatives from the US and several other countries demonstratively left the meeting during his speech.
On Monday, Russian Finance Minister Anton Siluanov and US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent held a meeting on the sidelines of the G20 Finance Ministers and Central Bank Governors Meeting.
